assemble.prompt: Match each term to its definition.

items.label: Alkaline
items.clue: Describes a solution with a pH above 7

items.label: Sodium hydroxide
items.clue: A common laboratory alkali, formula NaOH

items.label: Oxidation
items.clue: A reaction in which a substance gains oxygen.

items.label: Acid
items.clue: Has a pH below 7; cancelled out by an alkali.

questions.stem: Iron reacts with sulfur to make a single product. Which word equation is correct?

options.text: iron + sulfur → iron sulfate
iron + sulfur → iron sulfide
iron sulfide → iron + sulfur
iron + sulfur = iron sulfide

questions.explanation: Yes. Iron and sulfur join to make iron sulfide. The reactants go on the left, the product on the right, and the arrow means 'reacts to make'.

questions.stem: Magnesium (Mg) burns in oxygen (O₂) to make magnesium oxide (MgO). Which symbol equation is balanced and correct?

options.text: 2Mg + O₂ → Mg₂O₂
Mg + O₂ → 2MgO
2Mg + O₂ → 2MgO
Mg + O₂ → MgO + O

questions.explanation: Yes. Left: 2 Mg and 2 O. Right: 2MgO has 2 Mg and 2 O. The formulae are unchanged and every atom balances.

questions.stem: How many oxygen atoms are on each side of this equation? CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O

options.text: Left 2, right 3
Left 4, right 3
Left 4, right 2
Left 4, right 4

questions.explanation: Yes. 2O₂ has 2 × 2 = 4 oxygen atoms. On the right, CO₂ has 2 and 2H₂O has 2 × 1 = 2, so 4 in total.

questions.stem: What does the formula CO₂ tell you about one molecule of carbon dioxide?

options.text: It has two carbon atoms and a single oxygen atom
It has two carbon atoms and two oxygen atoms
It has one carbon atom and two oxygen atoms
It has one carbon atom and one oxygen molecule

questions.explanation: The small 2 applies only to the O before it: one carbon atom joined to two oxygen atoms.

questions.stem: In a chemical equation, what does the arrow (→) mean?

options.text: The two sides are the same substances
The reactants change into the products
The reactants are mixed with the products
The reactants have to be heated strongly

questions.explanation: The arrow means 'react to make': reactants on the left change into products on the right.

questions.stem: In the equation 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O, what does the large 2 in front of H₂O mean?

options.text: Two separate atoms of water are made
Each water molecule has two hydrogens
Two grams of water are made
Two molecules of water are made

questions.explanation: A large number in front of a formula shows how many of that molecule take part or are made.

questions.stem: A student balances H₂ + O₂ → H₂O by changing H₂O to H₂O₂. Why is this wrong?

options.text: It changes water into a different substance
It leaves the atoms unequal on the two sides
Formulae may be changed only for reactants
It should have been changed to H₄O₂

questions.explanation: Small numbers are part of a formula; changing them changes the substance. Balance with numbers in front.

questions.stem: Hydrogen (H₂) reacts with chlorine (Cl₂) to make hydrogen chloride (HCl). Which symbol equation is correct and balanced?

options.text: H₂ + Cl₂ → HCl
H₂ + Cl₂ → H₂Cl₂
H + Cl → HCl
H₂ + Cl₂ → 2HCl

questions.explanation: There are 2 H atoms and 2 Cl atoms on each side, and every formula is correct.
